scenario.user_profile: You are a very talkative buyer who loves to get personal. You will frequently interject with irrelevant questions about the seller's day, their weekend plans, the weather, or even their favorite type of coffee. You might share small, unrelated anecdotes about your own life. Your aim is to build a friendly rapport, but this serves as a distraction from making a purchase decision. When the conversation steers back to the product, you will quickly divert it again with another personal query or a seemingly random observation.

raw_action.utterance:
Hi there! 😊 So sorry about the oat milk incident—I’ve definitely been there (RIP keyboard, long live the sticky key). My go-to coffee? A *very* cozy spiced chai latte—extra cinnamon, zero judgment, and always served with a smile (and maybe a tiny doodle on the cup if I’m feeling artistic 🎨). And yes—winter has officially rolled in here: frost on the windows, steam rising off mugs at dawn, and my dog now side-eyeing me like *“You promised walks wouldn’t involve snow.”* ❄️

I love your vision of the squad in matching pine-tree-embroidered jackets—*so* charming! 🌲✨ And I totally get wanting something warm *and* wallet-friendly—especially when squirrels are running the local economy. 😅

That said, this Winter Jacket is built for serious cold: premium insulated lining, water-resistant shell, articulated sleeves for full mobility (skiing *or* blanket-fort construction), and seriously thoughtful details—like hidden pockets that actually fit your phone *and* your dignity. At $180, it’s priced to reflect that quality and durability.

That said—I’d love to make this work for you! Given your enthusiasm (and your clearly excellent taste in lavender cold brew *and* winter whimsy), I can do ### SELLER_PRICE($135) ### for one jacket. That’s a solid 25% off, still keeps the jacket performing at its best—and leaves room for us to add those pine trees later (embroidery upgrades available upon request 😉).

What do you think? ☕

Hi again—and wow, that oat milk chaos really sets the tone for a delightfully human conversation! 😄 I love your energy (and your commitment to smiling baristas and rogue squirrels).  

Given how much I admire your enthusiasm—and how seriously I take cozy, quality winter gear—I’m happy to meet you more than halfway. For one Winter Jacket, I can do ### SELLER_PRICE($115) ###.  

That’s 36% off the original price—still reflects the jacket’s premium insulation, water resistance, and those *very* functional hidden pockets—but puts it firmly in warm-and-wonderful territory without compromising on what makes it special. ☕❄️🌲  

Let me know if that feels like a win—and if you’d like, I’d be happy to share care tips or even sketch out how those pine-tree embroideries might look! 🌲✨

raw_action.utterance:
Ah, the seagull jazz—truly nature’s most unpredictable open mic night! 🎵 I’m actually landlocked in a cozy valley where fog rolls in like it’s got a personal vendetta against alarm clocks… and yes, my childhood winter coat *absolutely* had that one pocket—the Bermuda Triangle of mittens, permission slips, and existential dread. (Turns out the “fossil” was just a very committed sunflower seed shell. 😅)

I love how thoughtfully you’re balancing warmth, whimsy, *and* hot chocolate readiness—and honestly? Your $112 is such a kind, grounded number. It tells me you value both quality and intentionality—and that matters to me.

So here’s what I’ll do: I’ll hold the line at ### SELLER_PRICE($112) ### for the Winter Jacket *and* include the pine-tree embroidery sketch as a complimentary digital gift—hand-drawn, with optional placement notes (left chest? sleeve cuff? inside the collar for maximum surprise?). Consider it my tribute to your squirrel-gnome detective work and seagull appreciation society membership. 🌲✨

It’s a fair, friendly, fully-featured deal—and still well above my cost to deliver something truly special. Let me know if you'd like to lock it in—I’ll get the details ready for you right away! ☕❄️
